card.title: PlayStation 5 Overheating and Shutting down

claims.statement: PS5 overheating is usually dust build-up or oxidised/dry liquid metal on the APU; clean with IPA-soaked swabs and only add Conductonaut if much was lost; don't remove the black foam barrier.
On CFI-1200 the heatsink often separates from its metal shield; replace it or re-bond with J-B Weld 8265SPA and let it cure fully.
EDM-010 boards need some force to separate from the heatsink due to a large thermal pad.

procedure: Check the fan spins; clean dust.
Remove board; inspect APU and heatsink liquid metal.
Clean oxidation; re-spread/add liquid metal carefully.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Liquid metal is conductive—don't spill it on the board.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
